name: Pritanism ~Puritan no Senka no Yuuki~
original_name: Pritanism ～プリたんの戦火の勇気～
source:
Main character is an adventurer who belongs to a guild. He needs a support for a big battle, so he trains a rookie girl as a priest which is another name for "puritan" profession. Education includes both magic exercises and euphoric sexual rituals. How will it all end?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名隸屬於公會的冒險者。他需要為一場大戰準備支援，於是將一名新手女孩作為「清教徒」——一種牧師職業的別稱——來進行培養。教育內容既包括魔法修煉，也包括令人銷魂的性儀式。這一切將如何收場？

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]］
